data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month; opt in individually, not all-or-nothing. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, but recovery isn't guaranteed. This assumes those catches; other choices need recalculation. Intentions aren't enforceable, and long-run gains aren't assured. Each fisher: what's your exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
